newsitem.title: USA: AutoFinance completes asset backed note.
newsitem.headline: AutoFinance completes asset backed note.

text.p: KeyCorp's AutoFinance Group Inc said it issued $103.4 million of asset-backed notes through AFG Receivables Trust 1997-A.
The deal was issued in three tranches through underwriters Key Capital Markets Inc and Credit Suisse First Boston.

This transaction marks the first time a non-prime auto issuer has obtained triple-A ratings on a stand alone basis without the support of a surety bond wrap or other third party credit enhancement, the company said in a statement Friday.
The Class B Notes are rated single-A1 by Moody's, and single-A+ by S&P and Fitch.
The Class C Notes are rated triple-B by Moody's, S&P and Fitch.
